canvas.scaleMode: One fixed artboard, uniformly scaled to the output width

direction.hierarchy: Colorful app icon, large left-aligned product name, smaller for Mac line, brief tagline, one dominant actual Station window
decisions: Use the full actual Station window with its native chrome and unaltered interface pixels.
Keep the main window straight and fully inside the artboard.
Use quiet violet, cyan, and magenta ambient color around the window, with no tint or opacity overlay on the screenshot.
Omit the optional Music Flow inset: the Station dashboard already shows it, and a second screenshot would compete with the main interface.
No invented UI, fake call-to-action, letter monogram, feature metrics, live-status claims, or synthetic device state.

stationWindow.crop: None; retain the full supplied capture, including any existing viewport cutoff within the app

provenance.use: Large clear left copy, quiet dark field, actual app imagery dominant on the right. No reference pixels are used in the cover.

provenance.providedBy: Root agent, actual running native app capture
provenance.sourceStatus: Refreshed actual capture from the auxiliary installed app, supplied by root; canonical path inspected after refresh.
provenance.use: Only interface image used in the banner. Retain actual native titlebar and all supplied screenshot pixels.
provenance.editing: No painting, compositing fake controls, state-text removal, or generative reconstruction

provenance.role: Inspected supporting actual application screenshot, unused in cover
provenance.providedBy: Root agent, existing user-started live Music Flow window
provenance.use: Inspected for actual UI palette and product context; not composited into the final cover.

provenance.creationTool: OpenAI image generation tool (image_gen.imagegen), per root workflow
provenance.description: Silver light bar above a cyan, violet, and magenta light beam on a colorful macOS-style icon
provenance.use: Small brand icon beside the product hierarchy; no generated UI

verification.layoutReview: Independent read-only review: use one full straight Station window, omit the secondary inset, preserve native capture details, avoid live-state claims.
verification.renderStatus: V0 checked visually with T3 html_preview at 1280px; exact contentHeight and capturedHeight are 640px. Both actual assets rendered, all native screenshot chrome retained, no further screenshot crop. Root owns final persisted exports and review.
verification.localImageInlining: For T3 html_preview, replace ../app-icon.png and ../screenshots/station.png with absolute local file paths before submission.
verification.runtime: No external libraries, server, remote assets, animated content, viewport-height units, or html/body height:100%. Only deterministic artboard scaling uses JavaScript.
verification.rootReview: Both PNGs rendered from actual native screenshot assets with T3 html_preview; source UI pixels are unaltered. The 16, 32, 64 and 128 pixel icon representations were visually checked on dark and light backgrounds.
